name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Implementation Manager | Project Delivery & Cross-Functional Coordination

Builds structured project plans, tracks risk and blockers proactively, and runs a consistent communication cadence as the client's single point of contact. Comfortable coordinating technical and non-technical stakeholders and holding both internal teams and clients accountable to dates, without owning the underlying technical decisions.
